items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I had the things by Red Nichols and the Five Pennies

ctx.x: So I met him and my brother and well, I was kind of -- I think I talked more than my brother, you know, because I was talking to him and I says, I told him that I had their records, "Singing the Blues" he and Bix made, you know, and "The Riverboat Shuffle," and I said I had everything he'd

made. And I told him I had the things by Red Nichols and the Five Pennies, I had all of theirs. So he says, "Really?" I had on short pants -- you know Gary, in those days, you had to wear short pants, you know, until you -- you didn't hardly get a long suit, long pair of pants, until you was maybe 21 years old, until the later years, you know. So I had them on and knicker socks and my brother had on -- you know, he was eight years older. So I talked to him and I said, "I want to meet Bix, too." He says, "Well,…

So I'll never forget, when he fell in there, boy, he fell in with one of the prettiest ladies I ever seen in my life, just in time with his horn on his arm like this and he was tore up, he was higher than a kite.
